purpose: A rendering of the revision measurement each probe query takes for itself, published here so the number is readable without opening an envelope. It is NOT a second measurement and nothing reads it: each query measures its own file's history at run time and publishes the count, the HEAD, the branch and an ancestry verdict in its envelope, and those envelopes are the owners. Where this file and an envelope disagree, the envelope is right.
convention: commits touching queries/joern/<query id>.sc in the history of the HEAD named in measured_at_head, newest first, counted with an explicit HEAD in the range. EVERY commit returned is asserted to be an ancestor of that HEAD and the measurement is rejected if any is not, so a count can never include a commit that is not in this branch's history.

supersedes.why_it_was_replaced: that HEAD is not an ancestor of the HEAD above: the integration of this checkpoint collapsed the branch's internal per-unit commits into one commit, so the commits that generation counted stopped being in the history of the branch carrying these files. Its counts were correct at the HEAD it named and are unrepresentable at this one, which is exactly why the HEAD is published beside every count. The counts below were re-measured at the HEAD above and are the ones the three envelopes published there.
